name: astrotalk_reference_2002
verified_against: AstroTalk (astrotalk.com) free kundli — planetary positions, D9 navamsa, panchang, avakhada and avastha tables, 2026-08
why: Cross-checked against AstroTalk's published kundli for this birth. All nine planetary longitudes match to within one arcsecond (four exactly), the ascendant within five; every sign, nakshatra, house, avastha, panchang and avakhada value agrees, and the D9 navamsa reproduces placement for placement. Mahadasha dates sit one day from their Kundli tab and exactly on their Dasha tab, which disagree with each other — a rounding convention, not a defect. This is the fixture that makes the engine externally verified rather than merely self-consistent.
